verdict.heading: Three books cover most of what brings people here
verdict.intro: None of these is a long course, and none claims to do the Holy Spirit's job for you. They are honest, practical books — pick the one that matches the season you are in.

picks.label: Start here, especially if life just changed
picks.name: The Driver
picks.why: The newest book, and the one the author points new readers to. Twelve short chapters on letting God lead when you cannot see the road ahead — with reflection questions and a prayer at the end of each, drawn from his own testimony and the King James Bible.
points: Also available as PDF, not just EPUB

picks.label: For married couples
picks.name: Undivided
picks.why: A one-year devotional for couples pursuing demanding careers, a real marriage and children who know the Lord — without serving God in fragments. The longest book in the library, and the natural next step after The Driver.

picks.label: For marriage on solid ground
picks.name: God's Blueprint for a Strong Christian Marriage
picks.why: Marriage as a covenant, not a contract: love rooted in Christ, roles guided by Scripture, and prayer that holds a home together. The most complete book in the library on making a marriage last.

guide.heading: Pick the book that matches your season
guide.intro: Every book is an instant download in two formats — a PDF that opens on any phone or computer, and an EPUB that opens in Apple Books, Google Play Books, Kobo, Calibre, Adobe Digital Editions or the Kindle app. They are yours to keep and re-read.

points.h: The Driver — Trusting a Driver You Cannot See
points.p: The newest book, and the one to start with if recent events have taken away your sense of control. Twelve chapters on hearing God and following His map, closing each chapter with reflection questions and a prayer. Draws on the author's own testimony — a life turned around in 2010 and a season when they borrowed nothing and lacked nothing.

points.h: Undivided — A One-Year Devotional for Christian Couples
points.p: A year of daily readings for couples pursuing careers, a real marriage and children together. The longest book in the library, and the one to start with if you are married.

points.h: God's Blueprint for a Strong Christian Marriage
points.p: A biblical guide to love, trust and unity that lasts. Marriage as a covenant, not a contract. Pairs naturally with Undivided.
Biblical, practical wisdom for raising children who love God, honour His Word and live with godly character — in a culture that is not helping you.

points.h: Dating on Purpose — Courtship, Boundaries, and Discerning God's Will
points.p: For couples working out what a relationship looks like before marriage, from the talking stage to the wedding day — and for the people advising them.
Written for single believers under pressure to settle, or to treat singleness as a waiting room rather than a season.

points.h: Forgiving Forward — Releasing Resentment and Finding Freedom
points.p: On what to do with a grudge you have decided you are entitled to keep. What forgiveness is, what it is not, and how to forgive a wound that is still open.

points.h: Loving Like Jesus — Living Out the Gospel in Every Relationship
points.p: Everyday discipleship in ordinary relationships, which is where most of it is actually tested.

points.h: Unusual Obedience — When God Asks the Unexpected
points.p: For anyone at a crossroads where the instruction does not match the plan they had.

points.h: The Christian Journey — Holiness and Integrity
points.p: Foundational teaching on walking in uncompromising holiness and integrity when it costs something.
Thirteen Bible accounts retold for today, each with a key verse, a faith lesson, a reflection question and a prayer. A good starting point for newer believers, and for groups.
